name: Water Whip
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within short range. On a win, they take 1d4 damage. On a loss, half damage.

If the Condition you unchecked was Insecure, +1d damage.

Describe your water whip.
successes:
✨: Add HEART to the damage roll.

🌞: On a win, the creature is knocked prone.
